A '''Hunter-seeker Projectile Cannon'''<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a type of [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]]<ref name="RPG-Core" /> that fired explosive [[hunter-seeker missile]]s. [[E522 assassin droid/Legends|E522 assassin droids]] were equipped with a Hunter-seeker Projectile Cannon on their left arm<ref name="EGTD" /> loaded with six hunter-seeker missiles.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
